text:
Jordan: Quick sync — I'm putting together a short PRD for the "docs-as-contract" quickstarts. Want to pin acceptance criteria today so Dev can start on examples. Who's got 10m?
Priya: +1. Need clear launch gates: minimal quickstart, example app, and automated checks.
Eli: I can allocate a sprint ticket if acceptance criteria are final. Can we keep scope to 2 quickstarts max for MVP?
Jordan: That's the ask — MVP = 2 quickstarts (chat + embeddings). Each with: step-by-step quickstart, runnable code block, and CI smoke test.
Nora: DevEx note — quickstarts must be runnable with `yarn start` and a single env var `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. Keep deps <= 5 to avoid install flakiness.
Kai: Edge cases: offline model fallback, rate-limit errors, and token cost estimates. Do we include those in quickstart or separate troubleshooting doc?
Jordan: Put minimal fallback note in the quickstart (1–2 lines) and link to troubleshooting for details. Acceptance criteria should list what needs to be explicit in the quickstart.
Maya: UX: add a screenshot of console flow + expected request/response JSON for each quickstart. Helps reduce ambiguity in QA.
Eli: Proposed acceptance checklist: 
```
- Quickstart A (chat): runnable example, screenshot, JSON request/response, CI smoke test passes
- Quickstart B (embeddings): runnable example, minimal dataset import, similarity query sample, CI smoke test passes
- Docs-as-spec: examples used as tests in the PRD, edge cases enumerated, 1 fallback pattern documented
- Size/perf: install + run < 10 minutes on macOS/linux, code < 80 LOC per example (excluding deps)
```
Priya: Add: explicit rollout criteria — canary for 24h, metrics: quickstart onboarding completion rate, CI pass rate, and doc feedback >= 80% good/neutral from sample of 10 internal SEs.
Jordan: Good. Also call out non-go items: advanced routing, Dedicated-only configs, deep cost optimization — out of scope for MVP.
Nora: For CI smoke tests: use a lightweight recorded fixture (mocked API) and one live end-to-end test gated behind a token param to run in nightly only.
Kai: FYI: implementer note — include `sample_prompts.md` with 5 prompts covering edge cases like long context, repeated tokens, and function-calling examples.
Maya: I'll create the screenshot template and a small Figma kit for step flows.
Priya: Who owns the PRD doc? Jordan to draft, Priya to review, Nora + Eli to validate examples, Maya to sign off on screenshots.
Jordan: I'll start the PRD draft now, will paste an initial checklist here in thread. Can we lock acceptance criteria by EOD?
Eli: EOD works for me. If anything ambiguous I'll flag it here.
Nora: Same. I'll sketch the CI jobs after the checklist.
deploy-bot: Reminder: Docs repo deploy scheduled at 2026-03-21T02:00Z — quick changes before that will get a hotfix label.
Jordan: Thanks — will aim to get a PR in before the deploy window. If not, we'll queue for next window. :thumbsup:
Priya: Awesome. Jordan — ping when draft is up and I'll review.
Jordan: Will do. Attaching first-pass checklist in PR soon.
